title: Diary
summary: The day's timeline of meals, workouts, sleep, readings and observations.
description: The Diary is the home tab: one day at a time, with what went in, what was burned, and everything else logged that day.

stories.want: to see today's entries and where I stand against my calorie budget
stories.soThat: I know what room is left for dinner

requirements.text: The Diary shows one day's entries, newest first, and steps back and forward a day at a time between past days and today.

history.text: The Diary shows one day's entries in time order, and can step to any other day.
history.reason: Version 1 gave no order and claimed any day; the Diary lists newest first and cannot go past today.

requirements.text: The day's calorie bar shows net calories (eaten minus burned by workouts) against the day's target.
The Diary shows week and month totals beside the day's.

history.text: The Diary shows week and month totals; weeks run Monday to Sunday.
history.reason: Version 1 held two statements; the week's bounds are now DIA-6.

requirements.text: A week runs Monday to Sunday; a month is a calendar month.
Every entry kind opens a page of its own at `/entry/<kind>/<id>`, with kinds `meal`, `workout`, `sleep`, `state` (an observation), `reading`, `performance` and `supplement` (a legacy dose).

history.text: Every entry kind (meal, workout, sleep, reading, observation, performance) opens a page of its own at `/entry/<kind>/<id>`.
history.reason: Version 1 put observations at `observation`; their kind in the address is `state`, and legacy supplement doses have a page too.

requirements.text: Supplements are logged as food entries with the nutrients of the amount taken; nothing writes to the old supplement log.

history.text: Supplements are logged as food entries with the nutrients of the amount taken; there is no separate supplement log.
history.reason: Version 1 said there is no supplement log; the old log's tables and entries still exist until converted.

requirements.text: Legacy supplement-log entries are converted to food entries at app start when an API key is set, and are shown and counted until then.
